summary: Comprehensive testing of RDW Document Upload feature for License Plates. All backend APIs (16/16 tests) and frontend flows working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/license-plates/{plate_id}/document - PDF upload successful
Backend: POST /api/license-plates/{plate_id}/document - JPG upload successful
Backend: POST /api/license-plates/{plate_id}/document - PNG upload successful
Backend: POST /api/license-plates/{plate_id}/document - WEBP upload successful
Backend: File type validation - TXT files rejected with 400
Backend: File type validation - GIF files rejected with 400
Backend: File type validation - EXE files rejected with 400
Backend: File size validation - Files >10MB rejected with 400
Backend: DELETE /api/license-plates/{plate_id}/document - Document deleted successfully
Backend: DELETE returns 404 when no document exists
Backend: GET /api/license-plates returns document_url and document_filename fields
Backend: Uploaded documents accessible via /api/uploads/rdw/{filename}
Backend: Upload requires admin authentication (401 without token)
Backend: Delete requires admin authentication (401 without token)
Backend: Upload to nonexistent plate returns 404
Backend: Delete from nonexistent plate returns 404
Frontend: License plates page loads correctly
Frontend: 'RDW Document Uploaden' button visible for plates without documents
Frontend: File upload via button works correctly
Frontend: Success toast 'RDW document geüpload' appears after upload
Frontend: Green badge with filename appears after upload
Frontend: Download button opens document in new tab
Frontend: Delete (X) button visible next to document badge
Frontend: Confirmation dialog appears on delete click
Frontend: Success toast 'Document verwijderd' appears after delete
Frontend: Upload button reappears after document deletion
critical_code_review_comments: RDW document upload implementation is secure - validates file type and size on backend
File type validation uses content_type header (application/pdf, image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp)
File size limit of 10MB is enforced server-side
Documents stored in /app/backend/uploads/rdw/ with unique filenames
Old documents are automatically deleted when uploading a new one
Frontend correctly validates file type and size before upload
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing license plates XY-789-ZZ and AB-123-CD
context_for_next_testing_agent: RDW document upload feature fully tested and working. License plates XY-789-ZZ (id: 864bb4e4-97e2-4c29-8c54-0a697ba27ae2) and AB-123-CD (id: fb438b7d-7500-4ee6-8d3e-61335692ba57) exist in the database. Documents are stored in /app/backend/uploads/rdw/ directory.
